headings: Global Financial Service Providers Are Highly Regulated
Security and Data Protection Is Paramount for Global Financial Service Providers
paragraphs: As employees at financial institutions ("FIs") do their daily work and serve their clients, they often face inefficiencies from disparate systems, broken workflows, manual processes, and the inability to utilize their data effectively. This negatively impacts risk management, decision making, and the experiences of bankers and their clients. FIs need a unified platform that helps them reengineer every experience, from managing complex credit portfolios to streamlining account onboarding and loan origination.

nCino helps FIs of all sizes optimize their operations by embedding banking intelligence directly into the tools FI employees already use. nCino's data foundation, which was developed from the workflows, decisions, and outcomes of financial institutions, enables our platform to deliver artificial intelligence ("AI")-driven capabilities across our solutions. With the nCino Platform, FIs can:

•Operate More Intelligently. AI is reshaping the financial services industry, and nCino is helping FIs navigate the change effectively. We embed banking-specific intelligence directly into every stage of the customer lifecycle, turning our deep data foundation into actionable insights, automated workflows, and smarter decision-making across the nCino Platform.

•Improve Efficiency. nCino customers leverage the platform's capabilities to drive process efficiency by connecting previously disjointed functions, breaking down internal silos, and infusing intelligent automation into key workflows across multiple lines of business.

•Elevate Employee and Client Experiences. The nCino Platform's automation, workflow, and digitization capabilities work invisibly in the background to help eliminate redundant efforts, freeing FI employees to focus on relationships rather than transactions. This creates what nCino calls a Dual Workforce, where technology handles the burdensome workflows and amplifies human capabilities.

•Manage Risk and Compliance Continuously Rather Than Reactively. The nCino Platform can help FIs reduce regulatory, credit, and operational risk through intelligent workflows, data reporting, standardized risk modeling, and real-time reporting. Because the nCino Platform is highly configurable, it can adapt as regulations and the FI's risk requirements evolve.

nCino was originally founded in a bank to improve that institution's operations and client service. Its founders quickly realized that virtually all banks and credit unions faced the same core problems—cumbersome legacy technology, fragmented data, disconnected business functions, and a disengaged workforce. nCino was spun out as a separate company in late 2011 to help more institutions solve these challenges using cloud-based technology.

We initially focused on developing the nCino Platform to transform commercial and small business lending for community and regional banks in the U.S. We scaled the platform to enterprise banks in the U.S. in 2014, and then internationally in 2017. We have subsequently expanded across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Japan, and Asia-Pacific ("APAC").

Over the years, we have built and enhanced our products to ensure innovation and seamless integration across key solution lines of commercial, small business, and consumer banking including mortgage. We have strategically built and acquired technology, including SimpleNexus, DocFox, FullCircl, ILT, Visible Equity, FinSuite, and Sandbox Banking, to significantly augment the nCino Platform's capabilities for mortgage lending, onboarding, account opening, indirect auto lending, and advanced analytics and AI.

This approach has allowed us to create a unified platform of best-in-class intelligent solutions, underpinned by our rich data foundation, enabling FIs to replace multiple legacy systems, connect their operations, and streamline workflows and processes across various business lines to achieve desired impacts and process improvements.

nCino offers a trusted platform of best-in-class, intelligent solutions that unites people and data to help FIs enhance strategic decision-making, improve risk management, and elevate customer satisfaction. By integrating AI and actionable insights into the platform, nCino helps institutions consolidate legacy systems while creating experiences tailored to their specific needs. With the flexibility to select and implement either multiple solutions simultaneously or one at a time, institutions have the autonomy to design their experience with an agile platform that scales with their needs and provides integrated functionality with every new product or feature added.

Once implemented, the nCino Platform becomes embedded in our customers' business processes, enabling mission-critical workflows across the institution and allowing our customers to serve their clients anytime, anywhere, from any internet-enabled device.

The nCino Platform combines industry, customer, and process data with advanced analytics and AI—including explainable AI, predictive capabilities, and generative AI—to deliver intelligent solutions that drive real business outcomes. With intelligence embedded across the platform, nCino empowers institutions with intelligence-driven automation to optimize operations, enhance decision-making, and enrich banker and client experiences for accelerated growth and increased profitability. From automated document processing and real-time risk assessment to personalized insights and compliance monitoring, our intelligence capabilities work to amplify human capabilities and enable bankers to focus on decision-making and relationship building.

Fundamental elements of the nCino Platform are built on Salesforce (the "Salesforce Platform"), which allows the Company to focus product development efforts on building deep vertical functionality specifically for FIs, while leveraging Salesforce's global infrastructure, reliability, and scalability. In addition, nCino leverages Amazon Web Services ("AWS") as a cloud infrastructure layer, providing the data architecture necessary to deliver transformative intelligence capabilities at scale.

headings: Risks Relating to Our Business and Industry
We have a history of losses, and while we have achieved profitability, we may not be able to sustain profitability on a GAAP basis in the future.
If we are unable to attract new customers or continue to broaden our existing customers' use of our solutions, our revenue growth will be adversely affected.
We may not be able to sustain or increase our revenue growth rate in the future.
Our quarterly results may fluctuate significantly and may not fully reflect the underlying performance of our business.
The failure to attract and retain additional qualified personnel could prevent us from executing our business strategy.
We may not accurately predict the long-term rate of customer subscription renewals or adoption of our solutions, or any resulting impact on our revenues or operating results.
Because we recognize subscription revenues over the term of the contract, downturns or upturns in our business may not be reflected in our results of operations until future periods.
paragraphs: You should consider and read carefully all of the risks and uncertainties described below, as well as other information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our consolidated financial statements and related notes before making an investment decision with respect to our common stock. The risks described below are not the only ones we face. The occurrence of any of the following risks or additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe to be immaterial could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, or results of operations. In such case, the trading price of our common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment.

The below summary of risk factors provides an overview of many of the risks we are exposed to in the normal course of our business activities. As a result, the below summary risks do not contain all of the information that may be important to you, and you should read the summary risks together with the more detailed discussion of risks set forth following this section under the heading "Risk Factors," as well as elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Additional risks, beyond those summarized below or discussed elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, may apply to our activities or operations as currently conducted or as we may conduct them in the future or in the markets in which we operate or may in the future operate. Consistent with the foregoing, we are exposed to a variety of risks, including risks associated with the following:

•Our growth strategy increasingly depends on the adoption and effective use of our AI capabilities by our customers, and if customer adoption rates or usage do not meet our expectations, our business, results of operations, and competitive position could be adversely affected.

•Our increased focus on the development and use of AI/ML technologies in our solutions and our business, as well as our potential failure to effectively implement, use, and market these technologies, may result in reputational harm or liability, or could otherwise adversely affect our business.

•The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive and highly fragmented, and pricing pressure, rapidly evolving technologies, including the increasing adoption of AI/ML offerings by our competitors, or other competitive dynamics could adversely affect our business and results of operations.

•We derive most of our revenues from customers in the cloud-based financial services industry, and any downturn or consolidation or decrease in technology spend in the cloud-based financial services industry could adversely affect our business.

To help customers go live with our solutions, we offer professional services including configuration and implementation, training, and advisory services. For enterprise FIs, we generally work with SI partners such as Accenture, Deloitte, and PwC for the delivery of professional services for the nCino Platform. For regional FIs, we work with SIs such as West Monroe Partners, and for community banks, we work with SIs or perform configuration and implementation ourselves. We expect enterprise FIs to make up a greater proportion of our nCino Platform sales.

Our total revenues were $476.5 million, $540.7 million, and $594.8 million for fiscal 2024, 2025, and 2026, respectively, representing an 11.7% compound annual growth rate. Our subscription revenues were $409.5 million, $469.2 million, and $523.1 million for fiscal 2024, 2025, and 2026, representing a 13.0% compound annual growth rate. We recorded net income (loss) attributable to nCino in fiscal 2024, 2025, and 2026 of $(42.3) million, $(37.9) million, and $5.2 million, respectively. For fiscal 2026, our total subscription revenues include $17.3 million of inorganic revenues not present in comparative prior periods, consisting of FullCircl for the first three quarters of fiscal 2026 and Sandbox Banking following its acquisition on February 7, 2025 (the "Sandbox Acquisition Date"). We have included the financial results of Sandbox Banking in the consolidated financial statements from the Sandbox Acquisition Date. For fiscal 2026, our financial results also include the operating results of our fiscal 2025 acquisitions of DocFox, ILT, and FullCircl from their acquisition dates of March 20, 2024 (the "DocFox Acquisition Date"), April 1, 2024 (the "ILT Acquisition Date"), and November 5, 2024 (the "FullCircl Acquisition Date"), respectively.

Effective February 1, 2025, Pierre Naudé retired as the Company's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer and Sean Desmond was appointed to succeed Mr. Naudé as the Company's new President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Company's Board of Directors. On the same date, Mr. Naudé was appointed Executive Chairman of the Board. On February 1, 2026, Mr. Naudé transitioned to serving as a non-employee director and Chairman of the Board.

paragraphs: 在財務機構（"FIs"）的員工執行日常業務並為客戶服務時，他們經常面臨來自分散系統、破損的作業流程、手動流程以及無法有效運用其數據的低效率問題。這會對風險管理、決策以及銀行家及其客戶的體驗產生負面影響。FIs 需要一個統一的平台，協助他們重新設計每一項體驗，從管理複雜的信貸組合到簡化帳戶開戶及貸款發放流程。
nCino 幫助所有規模的 FIs 透過將銀行智慧直接嵌入 FI 員工已經使用的工具，來優化其運作。nCino 的數據基礎，是從財務機構的作業流程、決策與結果中發展而來，使我們的平台能夠在解決方案中提供人工智慧（"AI"）驅動的功能。透過 nCino 平台，FIs 可以：
•運作更智慧化。人工智慧正在重塑金融服務業，nCino 正協助 FIs 有效應對這項變革。我們將銀行特定的智慧直接嵌入客戶生命週期的每一個階段，將我們深厚的數據基礎轉化為可操作的見解、自動化流程以及在 nCino 平台中更智慧的決策。
•提高效率。nCino 的客戶利用平台的功能來推動流程效率，透過連接先前分離的功能，打破內部部門壁壘，並在多個業務線的關鍵流程中注入智慧自動化。
•提升員工與客戶的體驗。nCino 平台的自動化、流程與數位化功能在背景中運作，協助消除重複的工作，讓 FI 員工專注於人際關係而非交易。這創造出 nCino 所稱的雙重工作團隊（Dual Workforce），其中科技處理繁重的流程，並增強人類的作業能力。
•持續管理風險與合規，而非反應式管理。nCino 平台可以協助 FIs 透過智慧流程、數據報告、標準化的風險模型與即時報告，降低法規、信貸與運作風險。因為 nCino 平台高度可配置，因此可以隨著法規與 FI 的風險需求而進化。
nCino 最初是在一家銀行成立，以改善該機構的運作與客戶服務。其創始人很快發現，幾乎所有銀行與信用合作社都面臨相同的問題—過時的遺留技術、碎片化的數據、分離的業務功能以及缺乏投入的員工。nCino 於 2011 年晚期被分拆為一家獨立公司，以協助更多機構使用雲端技術解決這些挑戰。
我們最初專注於開發 nCino 平台，以轉型美國社區與地區銀行的商業與小型企業貸款業務。我們於 2014 年將平台擴展至美國的企業銀行，並於 2017 年擴展至國際市場。隨後，我們已擴展至北美、歐洲、中東、日本與亞太地區（"APAC"）。
多年來，本公司已建立並強化產品，以確保創新與商業、中小企業及消費金融包括房貸等關鍵解決方案線的順暢整合。本公司已戰略性地建立並取得技術，包括 SimpleNexus、DocFox、FullCircl、ILT、Visible Equity、FinSuite 及 Sandbox Banking，以顯著增強 nCino 平台在房貸貸款、入會、帳戶開立、間接汽車貸款及先進分析與 AI 方面的能力。
此方法使本公司得以建立一套最佳化智能解決方案的統一平台，基於本公司豐富的數據基礎，協助金融機構取代多個遺留系統、連接其作業流程，並跨各業務線簡化作業與流程，以達成預期的影響與流程改進。
nCino 提供一套受信賴的、最佳化智能解決方案的平台，將人員與數據結合，協助金融機構提升戰略決策能力、改善風險管理，並提高客戶滿意度。透過將 AI 與可操作的見解整合至平台，nCino 協助機構整合遺留系統，同時建立符合其特定需求的體驗。機構可選擇並實作多個解決方案同時進行或逐一進行，擁有自主權以設計其體驗，並透過具彈性的平台，根據其需求進行擴展，並在每次新增產品或功能時提供整合的功能。
一旦實施，nCino 平台將嵌入客戶的業務流程，使機構的關鍵作業流程得以跨機構運作，並使客戶能隨時、隨地，透過任何網路裝置為其客戶提供服務。

nCino 平台結合產業、客戶與流程數據與先進分析與 AI—包括可解釋的 AI、預測能力與生成式 AI—以提供智能解決方案，推動實際的業務成果。透過將智能嵌入平台，nCino 協助機構透過智能驅動的自動化，優化作業、提升決策能力，並豐富銀行人員與客戶的體驗，以加速成長與提高利潤率。從自動文件處理與即時風險評估，到個性化見解與合規監測，我們的智能能力協助增強人類能力，使銀行人員能專注於決策與關係建立。
nCino 平台的基本要素建於 Salesforce（"Salesforce 平台"），使本公司能專注於開發針對金融機構的深度垂直功能，同時利用 Salesforce 的全球基礎設施、可靠性與可擴展性。此外，nCino 並利用 Amazon Web Services（"AWS"）作為雲端基礎設施層，提供必要的數據架構，以在大規模上提供變革性的智能能力。

nCino最初是在銀行內成立，以改善該機構之營運與客戶服務。其創辦人迅速發現，幾乎所有銀行與信用合作社都面臨相同的核心問題—過時的遺留科技、分散的數據、脫節的業務功能及缺乏動機之員工。nCino於2011年底作為獨立公司成立，以協助更多機構運用雲端科技解決這些挑戰。
我們最初專注於開發nCino平台，以轉型美國社區與地區銀行之商業與小型企業貸款業務。我們於2014年將平台擴展至美國企業銀行，並於2017年擴展至國際市場。隨後，我們已於北美、歐洲、中東、日本及APAC地區擴展業務。

多年來，我們已建置並強化產品，以確保創新與商業、中小企業及消費金融包括房貸等關鍵解決方案線路的順暢整合。我們已戰略性地建置與取得技術，包括 SimpleNexus、DocFox、FullCircl、ILT、Visible Equity、FinSuite 以及 Sandbox Banking，以大幅增強 nCino 平台在房貸貸款、入會、帳戶開設、間接汽車貸款以及進階分析與 AI 方面的能力。此方法使我們得以建立一套最佳化智能解決方案的統一平台，基於我們豐富的數據基礎，使金融機構得以取代多個舊有系統、連接其作業，並簡化各業務線的作業流程與程序，以達成預期的影響與流程改善。
我們通常以訂閱方式提供 nCino 平台，根據不可取消的多年合約，合約通常為三至五年。nCino 已從單一產品流程解決方案進化為一套最佳化智能解決方案的平台。我們的智能解決方案架構定價模式有助於確保我們產品的價值定位與定價，並創造機會將智能嵌入所有解決方案中。
我們透過業務發展經理、帳戶經理、現場銷售工程師及客戶成功經理直接銷售解決方案。我們在美國的銷售努力是以金融機構的規模為基礎組織的，而在國際上，我們則以地理區域為重點進行銷售。截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，我們在美國有 185 名銷售及銷售支援人員，在美國以外的辦公室有 131 名銷售及支援人員。

為協助客戶啟用我們的解決方案，我們提供專業服務，包括設定與實作、培訓及諮詢服務。對於企業金融機構，我們通常與 SI 專業合作夥伴如 Accenture、Deloitte 及 PwC 合作，以提供 nCino 平台的專業服務。對於區域性金融機構，我們與 SI 如 West Monroe Partners 合作，而對於社區銀行，我們與 SI 合作或自行進行設定與實作。我們預期企業金融機構將佔 nCino 平台銷售的更大比例。

我們的總營收為 2024 財年 476.5 百萬美元、2025 財年 540.7 百萬美元、2026 財年 594.8 百萬美元，分別代表 11.7% 的複合年成長率。我們的訂閱營收為 2024 財年 409.5 百萬美元、2025 財年 469.2 百萬美元、2026 財年 523.1 百萬美元，分別代表 13.0% 的複合年成長率。我們在 2024 財年、2025 財年及 2026 財年的淨收入（虧損）歸屬於 nCino 分別為 (42.3) 百萬美元、(37.9) 百萬美元及 5.2 百萬美元。在 2026 財年，我們的總訂閱營收包含 17.3 百萬美元的非營運性收入，此收入未見於比較期間，包含 2026 財年前三季的 FullCircl 以及 Sandbox Banking 在 2025 年 2 月 7 日（"Sandbox 收購日"）收購後的收入。我們已從 Sandbox 收購日開始將 Sandbox Banking 的財務結果納入合併財務報表中。在 2026 財年，我們的財務結果也包含 2025 財年收購 DocFox、ILT 及 FullCircl 的營運結果，分別為 DocFox 收購日 2024 年 3 月 20 日（"DocFox 收購日"）、ILT 收購日 2024 年 4 月 1 日（"ILT 收購日"）及 FullCircl 收購日 2024 年 11 月 5 日（"FullCircl 收購日"）。
自 2025 年 2 月 1 日起，Pierre Naudé 離職擔任本公司董事長及首席執行官，Sean Desmond 被任命為接任 Mr. Naudé 擔任本公司新任董事長及首席執行官，並成為本公司董事會成員。同日，Mr. Naudé 被任命為董事會執行主席。2026 年 2 月 1 日，Mr. Naudé 遷移為非員工董事及董事會主席。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關之風險
本公司有虧損之歷史，雖然我們已達成獲利，但未來可能無法在一般會計準則（GAAP）基礎上維持獲利。
若我們無法吸引新客戶或持續擴展現有客戶對我們解決方案之使用，將會對我們之營業收入成長產生負面影響。
本公司可能無法維持或提高未來之營業收入成長率。
本公司每季之營運結果可能有顯著波動，且可能無法完全反映本公司業務之實際表現。
若無法吸引並留住更多合格之人才，將可能影響本公司執行業務策略。
本公司可能無法準確預測客戶訂閱續約之長期比率或解決方案之採用率，或任何對本公司營收或營運結果之影響。

paragraphs: 您應仔細考慮並閱讀下列所描述的所有風險與不確定性，以及本年度報表（Form 10-K）中包含的其他資訊，包括標題為「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」的章節，以及我們的合併財務報表與相關附註，以作為投資本公司普通股的決策依據。下列所描述的風險並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。上述任何風險或目前未為我們所知、或我們目前認為不重要的其他風險與不確定性，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運結果造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能會下跌，您可能會損失全部或部分投資。

下列風險因素摘要提供了我們在正常業務活動中所面臨的許多風險概述。因此，下列摘要風險並未包含所有對您可能重要的資訊，您應將摘要風險與本節後續標題為「風險因素」的更詳細風險討論內容，以及本年度報表（Form 10-K）其他地方的資訊一併閱讀。除了下列摘要風險或本年度報表（Form 10-K）其他地方所討論的風險之外，可能還存在其他風險，這些風險可能適用於我們目前或未來可能進行的業務活動，或我們目前或未來可能經營的市場。
• 我們的成長策略越來越依賴客戶對我們 AI 能力的採用與有效使用，若客戶採用率或使用情況未達我們的預期，可能會對我們的業務、營運結果與競爭地位造成不利影響。
• 我們對 AI/ML 技術在解決方案與業務中的發展與應用日益重視，以及我們可能未能有效實施、使用與行銷這些技術，可能會導致聲譽損害或法律責任，或可能以其他方式對我們的業務造成不利影響。
• 我們所參與的市場競爭激烈且高度分散，價格壓力、快速演進的技術，包括競爭對手對 AI/ML 產品的日益採用，或其他競爭動態，可能會對我們的業務與營運結果造成不利影響。
• 我們的收入大多來自雲端金融服務業的客戶，若雲端金融服務業出現衰退或併購，或科技支出減少，可能會對我們的業務造成不利影響。
